bibl.title: Ritual Intercession in the Ptolemaic Kingdom. A Survey of Grammar, Semantics and Agency.

bibl.note: Paper presented at the panel Meet the New Gods, Same as the Old Gods? Formulary, Ritual, and Status in Hellenistic Ruler Cult, hosted by the 8th Celtic Conference in Classics, Edinburgh, June 25-28, 2014. - 1. Ritual communication in an inter-medial approach. - 2. Questioning status ambiguity. - 3. Religious and social implications of ritual intercession. - 4. Second-century dedications and social dynamics in the buffer zone between Thebaid and Nubia. - 5. Intercultural contexts. - 6. Conclusive remarks.
